low_risk.definition: changes that are configuration- or prompt-level candidates with clear rollback, no production application in this cycle, and no dependence on new external integrations

medium_risk.definition: changes that alter routing decisions, eligibility criteria, or business-rule interpretation and therefore require explicit validation before any patch is proposed

high_risk.definition: changes that could affect production behavior broadly, depend on live infrastructure, or require direct edits in the real project or production stack

explicit_non_goals: no patch generation in this preparation round
no bindings to the real workspace
